exposure: stillbirth at 23 weeks of gestation or more
cohort: Female Florida residents aged 13-54 years old who gave birth between 2005 and 2014
finding: Delivering a stillborn fetus at or after 23 weeks of gestation is associated with a significantly increased risk of severe maternal morbidity, particularly in women with pre-existing comorbidities.
mod_finding: Deliveries were stratified by maternal comorbidities, and mode of delivery was adjusted for in the multivariable analysis of severe maternal morbidity after stillbirth compared to live birth.
